name: Personal Research Specialist — Deterministic Baseline
description: Controlled benchmark for evidence extraction, question answerability and citation traceability. It is not a factuality or external-source-quality benchmark.

sources.title: Battery maintenance notes
sources.excerpt: Lithium-ion battery capacity gradually decreases as the cells age. High operating temperatures accelerate chemical degradation inside lithium-ion cells. A swollen battery should be removed from service and handled using approved safety procedures. A laptop battery should be stored with a partial charge during long periods of inactivity.

sources.title: Charging cable inspection notes
sources.excerpt: A damaged charging cable can cause intermittent charging and localized heat near a connector.

sources.title: Laptop cooling notes
sources.excerpt: Blocked air vents restrict airflow and can cause a laptop to overheat. Dried thermal paste can reduce heat transfer from the processor to the heat sink. Heavy processor workloads increase power consumption and heat generation.

sources.title: Storage technology notes
sources.excerpt: An SSD stores data in flash memory cells and has no moving mechanical parts.

sources.title: SSD reliability notes
sources.excerpt: An SSD with worn flash cells may enter read-only mode to protect existing data. Keeping backups on a separate device reduces the impact of drive failure. SMART wear indicators can provide an early warning of declining drive health.
